name: Celebrity Story 8min
description: 8+ minute celebrity documentary — unlocks mid-roll ads (~2x RPM). Long scenes (8-12s narration units) are punch-cut into 2-3 visual shots at sentence boundaries, so the on-screen cut rate stays at 3-5s while asset fetching stays sane.

script.tone: dramatic, investigative, engaging, slightly sensational but factual
script.persona: You are a captivating documentary narrator telling a gripping true story about a famous public figure. Your tone is serious but accessible. You use vivid language and build suspense. You present facts without making legal accusations.
script.hook_style: Start with the most shocking or dramatic moment of the story, then say something like 'But to understand how we got here, we need to go back to the beginning...'
content_guidelines: Always state alleged events as 'allegedly' or 'according to reports'
Include specific dates and verifiable facts
Mention key people involved by their full names
Do not make definitive legal judgments — present what is publicly known
Escalate stakes at the midpoint: a revelation that reframes everything before it
End with a thought-provoking question to the audience
